properties.description: what_next answers in four bands, the exploration slot is not optional, and liveness is what makes the shaping band readable (crates/reflow2-core/tests/what_next.rs, 11 cases). THE ONE THAT MUST NEVER REGRESS is a_marked_decision_is_never_ranked_however_it_would_score: a `proposed` Decision carrying AUTHORED_BY role=approver is the user's own durable self-prioritisation — it already existed and was simply never named one — and no computed score may reorder it or demote it into the ranked band, so the test gives a marked decision every scoring signal available and asserts it still never appears there. THE SECOND LOAD-BEARING CASE is a_decision_nothing_points_at_is_still_surfaced. Every ranking signal here is built on connectedness, so a decision nothing points at scores zero forever and would never be shown — dec:bl-155's unused-versus-unreachable trap arriving through a ranking instead of a usage count. A suite that only checked the ranking would stay green while the fifth slot was dropped as over-engineering, which is precisely what the two independent derivations of that slot (the Q-table framing, and Anthony's own "top 4 and bottom 1") exist to prevent. THE SHAPING BAND'S CASES PIN A CAVEAT THIS DESIGN RECORDED BEFORE THE CODE EXISTED: cap:what-next warned that raw GOVERNED_BY in-degree is the wrong signal because its top hit was a pruning decision governing ten DROPPED requirements, and a_decision_governing_only_retired_work_does_not_shape_anything IS that fixture — a 9-dead-node decision must lose to a 3-live-node one. ALSO PINNED: retired governed nodes are COUNTED and reported rather than silently dropped; the shaping band holds only ACCEPTED decisions, never open ones, because it answers a different question for a different reader; `alignment: supporting` on a CONTRADICTS edge is corroboration and must not raise the score, which heal.rs paid for once already; `decision:ack:` review records are excluded both as decisions and as governed sources, because they dominate raw GOVERNED_BY counts (measured, excluding them took that edge type from 867 to 255) so leaving them in makes the answer confidently wrong rather than merely noisy; the unexplored pick is stable across two readings of an unchanged design and ADVANCES when a decision is settled, since the core takes no clock and no RNG and the rotation is derived from the count of accepted decisions; and `not_shown` accounts for every open decision the answer omitted. WHAT IS NOT COVERED, stated rather than left to be discovered: nothing here checks that the WEIGHTS are right. They are a deliberately coarse guide against a stated acceptance criterion of "general ballpark", and the tests assert the ORDER the signals produce, never the absolute numbers.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED: removing the band-1 short-circuit fails exactly that test and no other. MUTATION-CHECKED: removing the liveness filter fails exactly the two liveness tests and no others. breadth_of_governed_types_is_reported_but_never_ranks pins the refinement that was TRIED AND REJECTED on measurement — weighting by distinct governed types demotes every exemplar the capability names as correct, because governing eight Components is shaping and single-typedness is not shallowness — so `shapes` is reported and kept out of the score.
properties.name: what_next answers in four bands, and the exploration slot is not optional
